rows.note: p = 0.55 · unchanged by design: the dolly, the rise and the one dissolve are the owner-ratified film.

rows.label: The gold lands
rows.note: p = 0.82 · rim-glow + vignette arc as before; the veil has not started (0.88).

rows.label: Title carves
rows.note: p = 0.90 · wordmark condensing; in the candidate the floor has begun to melt and the credit rule is about to draw.

rows.label: THE LANDING

rows.label: THE SEAM (+160 px)

rows.label: Handoff (+720 px)
rows.note: the hero composes; the film's last third is paper.

boards.title: Desktop 1440×900 · dark · landing + handoff
boards.subtitle: The film is theme-invariant; the veil and the page-side fade are token-driven, so in dark mode the floor sinks into the night canvas instead of paper.
